mainEntity.name: What does this book explain about AI in business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Where AI can save time in a small business without taking over the business

mainEntity.name: Who gets the most value from this business guide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small business owners, sole traders, freelancers, consultants, indie authors, local service providers, creators and small teams who want practical AI use without technical waffle.
It runs to 233 pages and focuses on Marketing support, admin, customer service, research, planning, content workflows, automation boundaries, privacy, quality control and cost discipline.
